content: bubbles/viewport: viewport.Model embeds in app model. Init: viewport.New(width, height). Set content: vp.SetContent(str). Render: vp.View(). Update: vp, cmd = vp.Update(msg). Responds to WindowSizeMsg for resize. Scrolling: ScrollDown/ScrollUp/PageDown/PageUp/GotoTop/GotoBottom methods. Mouse wheel support via MouseWheelEnabled. High performance mode for alternate screen. Handles ANSI escape sequences in content for correct line width calculation. Use bubbles/viewport for both FileTree pane and DiffView pane scroll management.
